claims.statement: Operations at the proposed water-based paint manufacturing facility in Madhya Pradesh would commence within three years from the date of receipt of Environmental Clearance.
claims.quote: The operations at the proposed facility would commence within three years from the date of receipt of Environmental Clearance for setting up of the manufacturing facility by the Company.
claims.speaker: management
claims.horizon: within three years from the date of receipt of Environmental Clearance

facts.statement: The Company has long-term borrowings of 805.42 crores as on 31st March 2026.
facts.quote: The Company has long-term borrowings of ` 805.42 crores as on 31st March 2026, arising pursuant to the amalgamation of Asian Paints (Polymers) Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, with the Company.

facts.statement: Cash and cash equivalents and other bank balances, current/non-current term deposits, investments in debentures or bonds and mutual funds on a standalone basis stood at 9,014.60 crores as on 31st March 2026.
facts.quote: Cash and cash equivalents and other balances with Banks (excluding earmarked balances), current/non-current  term deposits as disclosed in other financial assets, investments in debentures or bonds (including interest  accrued on the same) and mutual funds on a standalone basis as on 31st March 2026, stood at ₹ 9,014.60 crores as against ₹ 4,533.55 crores in the previous financial year.

facts.statement: The Company proposed to set up a water-based paint manufacturing facility in Madhya Pradesh with a capacity of 4 lakh KL per annum and an estimated investment of ~2,000 crores.
facts.quote: The Company had announced its proposal to set up a  water-based paint manufacturing facility in the State of  Madhya Pradesh with a proposed capacity of 4 lakh KL per  annum and an estimated investment of ~` 2,000 crores.

facts.statement: Berger Paints Emirates Ltd Co (L.L.C) initiated the process for setting up its second paint manufacturing facility in UAE with an estimated investment of AED 140 million and initial capacity of 55,800 KL per annum.
facts.quote: During the year, Berger Paints Emirates Ltd Co (L.L.C), UAE,  a step‑down subsidiary of Asian Paints International Private  Limited, Singapore, a wholly owned subsidiary of the  Company, initiated the process for setting up its second  paint manufacturing facility in the United Arab Emirates with  an estimated investment of AED 140 million (~₹ 340 crores)  with an initial capacity of 55,800 KL per annum.
